name: Pink World 3 - Office Edition -
source: You, an accountant, have been tasked to work an all-night shift to meet a deadline with your co-workers. However, after the sky turned pink inexplicably, the ''growing'' tasks suddenly don't feel so bad!
translation: 作为一名会计师，你的任务是通宵工作，以便与同事在截止日期前完成工作。不过，当天空莫名其妙变成粉红色后，‘成长’的任务突然感觉没那么糟糕了！
